homepage.tagline: The biggest Sun* talent recognition event of the year
homepage.kudosPromoBody:
NEW IN SAA 2025
A peer recognition and appreciation activity — happening for the first time for all Sunners. Launching in November 2025, encouraging Sun* members to share recognition and appreciation on the official platform. These will be used as reference material by the Heads Council when selecting award recipients.
homepage.rootFurtherParagraph1:
Faced with the rapidly changing landscape of the AI era and increasingly high demands from clients, Sun* has chosen a strategy of capability diversification — not only striving to become elite in its field, but aiming even higher: a place where every Sunner is a "problem-solver", an expert at resolving every challenge, finding solutions to every project, client, and societal problem.
Drawing inspiration from diverse capabilities, flexible growth, and the spirit of going deeper to break through in the AI era, "Root Further" was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards 2025.
Beyond its surface meaning, "Root Further" is the journey of continuously reaching farther, rooting deeper, touching the hidden "geological layers" to sustain existence, rise up, and nurture the ever-burning passion for creating value that defines Sun* people.
homepage.rootFurtherQuote:
"A tree with deep roots fears no storm"
(English Proverb)
homepage.rootFurtherParagraph2: Before the storm, only trees with strong enough roots can stand firm. An organization of individuals confident in diverse capabilities, ready to create and embrace challenges, and in command of change — is an organization that not only stands firm amid turbulence, but also harnesses every advantage to conquer the challenges of the times. More than just the name of a new chapter in the organization's development journey, "Root Further" is also an encouragement for each of us to dare to believe in ourselves, dare to go deep, unlock all potential, dare to break limits, and become the most versatile and excellent version of ourselves.

descriptions.top-talent: The Top Talent award honors all-around outstanding individuals — those who consistently demonstrate strong expertise, exceptional work performance, and always deliver value beyond expectations, highly regarded by clients and teammates. With a spirit of readiness to take on any mission entrusted by the organization, they are a source of inspiration, driving motivation and creating a positive influence on the entire team.
descriptions.top-project: Recognizing the outstanding project that excels across all dimensions with remarkable revenue, delivering exceptional value to clients and the organization.
descriptions.top-project-leader: Recognizing the inspiring manager who leads projects to breakthrough results that exceed expectations.
descriptions.best-manager: Recognizing the manager with strong management skills who leads their team effectively, builds a positive work environment, and drives sustainable growth.
descriptions.signature-2025: Recognizing the individual or team with the most distinctive creative contribution in 2025, leaving a unique mark and making an outstanding contribution to the Sun* community.
descriptions.mvp: Recognizing the individual with the greatest contribution to the organization — someone who creates comprehensive impact, excels in capability, spirit, and real-world results.

theLeModal.title: Rules
theLeModal.sectionABody:
Receive Kudos from colleagues to accumulate Hero badges:
- New Hero: 1–4 Kudos
- Rising Hero: 5–9 Kudos
- Super Hero: 10–19 Kudos
- Legend Hero: 20+ Kudos
theLeModal.sectionBBody: Send Kudos to unlock 6 mystery boxes. Collect all 6 mystery icons to receive a special gift from the organizing committee.
theLeModal.sectionCBody: The top 5 most-liked Kudos (most hearts received) will receive a special prize from SAA 2025.
